<?php
class AssertionsOption101 {
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",ini_get("precision"),";";return "zend.assertions";}
    public function __destruct() {
        echo "O:",ini_get("precision"),":",$GLOBALS["row"][0],":",$GLOBALS["leaf"],";";
        $GLOBALS["leaf"]=42;ini_set("precision",21);
    }
}
class AssertionsArray101 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0;
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$GLOBALS["name"]:$GLOBALS["row"];}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {
        echo "N",$this->pos,";";
        if($this->pos===0){unset($GLOBALS["name"]);}else{$GLOBALS["row"][0]=31;$GLOBALS["leaf"]=17;}
        ++$this->pos;
    }
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
function makeArray101() {$it=new AssertionsArray101;$GLOBALS["iterWatch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$name=new AssertionsOption101;$leaf=7;$row=[3,&$leaf];
$optionWatch=WeakReference::create($name);$iterWatch=null;$result=99;
echo "B;";
try {$result=ini_set(...makeArray101());echo "BAD;";}
catch(TypeError $e) {
    echo "E:",$e->getMessage()==='ini_set(): Argument #2 ($value) must be of type string|int|float|bool|null',":",$result,":",ini_get("precision"),":",$optionWatch->get()===null,":",$iterWatch->get()===null,":",$row[0],":",$leaf,";";
    $trace=$e->getTrace();$arg=$trace[0]["args"][1];
    echo "A:",$trace[0]["args"][0],":",$arg[0],":",$arg[1],":",$row[0],":",$row[1],";";
    $leaf=66;$row[0]=55;
    echo "F:",$arg[0],":",$arg[1],":",$row[0],":",$row[1],";";
    unset($arg,$trace,$e);
}
ini_restore("precision");echo "Z;";
purpose: After temporary Iterator cleanup, Stringable option converts to zend.assertions and retires; copied COW array is rejected before directive lookup, retaining table and alias in TypeError TraceArgs.

<?php
class AssertionsOptionObject101 {
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",ini_get("precision"),";";return "zend.assertions";}
    public function __destruct() {echo "O:",ini_get("precision"),";";ini_set("precision",21);}
}
class AssertionsValueObject101 {
    public function __toString():string {echo "BAD;";return "8";}
    public function __destruct() {echo "V:",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
class AssertionsIteratorObject101 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0;
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$GLOBALS["name"]:$GLOBALS["value"];}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";if($this->pos===0){unset($GLOBALS["name"]);}else{unset($GLOBALS["value"]);}++$this->pos;}
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
function makeObject101() {$it=new AssertionsIteratorObject101;$GLOBALS["iterWatch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$name=new AssertionsOptionObject101;$value=new AssertionsValueObject101;
$optionWatch=WeakReference::create($name);$valueWatch=WeakReference::create($value);$iterWatch=null;$result=99;
echo "B;";
try {$result=ini_set(...makeObject101());echo "BAD-RETURN;";}
catch(TypeError $e) {
    echo "E:",$e->getMessage()==='ini_set(): Argument #2 ($value) must be of type string|int|float|bool|null',":",$result,":",ini_get("precision"),":",$optionWatch->get()===null,":",$valueWatch->get()!==null,":",$iterWatch->get()===null,";";
    $trace=$e->getTrace();$arg=$trace[0]["args"][1];
    echo "A:",$trace[0]["args"][0],":",$arg===$valueWatch->get(),";";
    unset($arg,$trace,$e);
    echo "R:",$valueWatch->get()===null,";";
}
ini_restore("precision");echo "Z;";
purpose: After option conversion and disposal, zend.assertions rejects the copied Stringable object value without casting it; TraceArgs retains the object until catch releases it.

<?php
class AssertionsControlOption101 {
    public string $id; public string $option;
    public function __construct($id,$option) {$this->id=$id;$this->option=$option;}
    public function __toString():string {echo "T:",$this->id,":",$GLOBALS["stage"],";";return $this->option;}
    public function __destruct() {echo "D:",$this->id,":",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
class AssertionsControlIterator101 implements Iterator {
    public int $pos=0; public AssertionsControlOption101 $name;
    public function __construct() {$this->name=new AssertionsControlOption101("A","zend.assertions");}
    public function rewind():void {echo "W;";$this->pos=0;}
    public function valid():bool {echo "V",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos<2;}
    public function current():mixed {echo "C",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos===0?$this->name:7;}
    public function key():mixed {echo "K",$this->pos,";";return $this->pos;}
    public function next():void {echo "N",$this->pos,";";$this->pos++;if($this->pos===2){$GLOBALS["stage"]="done";}}
    public function __destruct() {echo "I:",ini_get("precision"),";";}
}
function makeControl101() {$it=new AssertionsControlIterator101;$GLOBALS["watch"]=WeakReference::create($it);return $it;}
$stage="walk";$watch=null;echo "B;";
$result=ini_set(...makeControl101());echo "R:",$result,":",ini_get("precision"),":",($watch->get()===null?1:0),";";
unset($watch);ini_restore("precision");echo "E;";
purpose: Explicit boundary: a copied scalar value with converted zend.assertions option is outside the new type-rejection priority and remains Unsupported.
unsupported_reason: CONFIG Iterator Stringable option outside normal scalar reception
